setup.edifice: Add a building to the project
setup.unitTypeHint: For example two-bedroom apartment or shop.

guide.projectNameText: The name buyers see on your website, such as “Riviera Residence”.
guide.projectCommissionText: The share of the price your agent earns on each sale in this project. A unit can have its own rate.
guide.projectImageText: Buyers see it first. You'll outline each building on it, so a photo of the whole site works best.
guide.projectPricesText: Show prices on your website, or hide them so buyers ask you. Buildings and units follow this unless you change it for one of them.
guide.edificeNameText: Such as “Block A”. It helps buyers and your team tell your buildings apart.
guide.edificeAddressText: Choose the country and city, then the street and postal code, and place the pin on the map. Your website and emails show this address.
guide.edificeInvestmentText: What was put into the building. Your dashboard and return reports use it; it doesn't change unit prices.
guide.edificeImageText: Upload a photo of the building. It shows on your website, and you'll outline each floor on it.
guide.floorEdificeText: Choose the building first. Its photo then opens below, so you can outline this floor on it.
guide.floorNameText: Such as “Ground floor” or “Floor 3”, the way buyers would say it.
guide.floorLevelText: 0 for the ground floor, 1 for the first, -1 for a basement. It keeps your floors in the right order.
guide.floorPlanText: Upload the plan of this floor as its main image. You'll outline each unit on it.
guide.categoryNameText: A broad group, such as “Residential” or “Commercial”. Each unit type goes under one.
guide.unitTypeNameText: Name it the way buyers say it, such as “Two-bedroom apartment” or “Shop”. It shows on each unit's page.
guide.unitTypeCategoryText: The group it belongs to, such as the “Residential” category you just added.
guide.unitFloorText: Choose the project, building and floor. The floor plan then opens below, so you can outline the unit on it.
guide.unitNumberText: The number you know it by, such as “A-12”. Use the same one as on your plans and contracts.
guide.unitKindText: Pick one of the types you added. Buyers see it on the unit's page.
guide.unitPriceText: The asking price. Buyers see it on your website unless you chose to hide prices.

tour.introText: This part of the panel runs your property sales and rentals: your projects, buildings and units, buyers from first contact to handover, payments and commissions, rentals, reports, and your rules. Next, the tour opens each page and explains it. The ⓘ beside a page's title shows the same help any time.
